apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: GithubAccessTokenSpec defines the desired state to generate a GitHub access token.

appID.description: AppID is the GitHub App ID. Exactly one of AppID or AppIDRef must be set.

appIDRef.description: AppIDRef references a secret key containing the GitHub App ID. Exactly one of AppID or AppIDRef must be set.

key.description:
A key in the referenced Secret.
Some instances of this field may be defaulted, in others it may be required.

name.description: The name of the Secret resource being referred to.

namespace.description:
The namespace of the Secret resource being referred to.
Ignored if referent is not cluster-scoped, otherwise defaults to the namespace of the referent.

auth.description: Auth configures how ESO authenticates with a Github instance.

privateKey.description: GithubSecretRef references a secret containing GitHub credentials.

secretRef.description:
SecretKeySelector is a reference to a specific 'key' within a Secret resource.
In some instances, `key` is a required field.

key.description:
A key in the referenced Secret.
Some instances of this field may be defaulted, in others it may be required.

name.description: The name of the Secret resource being referred to.

namespace.description:
The namespace of the Secret resource being referred to.
Ignored if referent is not cluster-scoped, otherwise defaults to the namespace of the referent.

installID.description: InstallID is the GitHub App installation ID. Exactly one of InstallID or InstallIDRef must be set.

installIDRef.description:
InstallIDRef references a secret key containing the GitHub App installation ID. Exactly one of InstallID or
InstallIDRef must be set.

key.description:
A key in the referenced Secret.
Some instances of this field may be defaulted, in others it may be required.

name.description: The name of the Secret resource being referred to.

namespace.description:
The namespace of the Secret resource being referred to.
Ignored if referent is not cluster-scoped, otherwise defaults to the namespace of the referent.

permissions.description: Map of permissions the token will have. If omitted, defaults to all permissions the GitHub App has.

repositories.description:
List of repositories the token will have access to. If omitted, defaults to all repositories the GitHub App
is installed to.

url.description: URL configures the GitHub instance URL. Defaults to https://github.com/.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of the fields in [appID appIDRef] must be set
exactly one of the fields in [installID installIDRef] must be set
